PG14_BIN.help: the folder holding PostgreSQL 14's pg_config: brew install postgresql@14 on macOS, postgresql-server-dev-14 on Linux

areas: turning Postgres quals into plugin requests (quals.go, helpers.go)
converting plugin rows into Postgres values (conversion_infos.go, helpers.go)
the C extension's planning and scan callbacks (fdw/)
plugin connections and the hub's scan iterators (hub/)
SQL generated for foreign tables and schemas (schema.go, sql/)
